type.description: Which taxonomy the rule works in: `from` and `to` are both labels of this type.

from.description: The broad categories this rule narrows: it only ever moves an app whose category, after every other signal, is one of these.

to.description: The finer category the app moves to.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression source string, matched case-insensitively against the app's display name, its `shortDescription` and, when an LLM verdict applies to it, that verdict's short `reason` (never `longDescription`: incidental phrases in long prose are false positives). Use `\b` word boundaries.

reason.description: Why the phrase reliably means the finer category, with what was sampled — so the rule stays auditable.

title: Enrich: category refinements
description: Moves an app from a broad category to a finer one when its name, short description or LLM verdict reason names the finer one — run after every other category signal, so it applies whichever signal chose the broad category (a generic freedesktop 'Network' tag, a distro section like Debian's 'net', a name or description rule, an LLM verdict, including one stored under a legacy label). First matching rule wins, in file order. See docs/categories.md.
